VMT.Linkage.Title: Linkage Repair
VMT.Linkage.Hint: Rebuild broken uuid links between a host compendium and a child compendium by matching names
VMT.Linkage.WarnBody: Picking the wrong host or child compendium corrupts compendium data. Broken links can strip a host document of every linked child, requiring manual reconstruction. Confirm both compendiums and unlock the host before continuing.
VMT.Linkage.Intro: This tool repairs uuid links stored in an array field on each host document (for example classes or races) by pointing them at the matching documents in a child compendium (for example class features or racial traits). Useful after a world migration, server transfer, or compendium re-import.
VMT.Linkage.Match: Links are rebuilt by matching child document names. Any entry that cannot be resolved by name is left untouched and listed for manual repair.
VMT.Linkage.OnlyUuid: Only the uuid field of each link entry is rewritten. Every other field on both compendiums is preserved.
VMT.Linkage.NoPacks: No Item compendiums found. Nothing changed.
VMT.Linkage.ConfigHint: Pick the preset that matches your link shape, or Custom for any other array field, then choose host and child. Swapping host and child corrupts both.
VMT.Linkage.PresetPath: Repairs the {path} array on each host document.
VMT.Linkage.hostHint: The compendium whose documents hold the broken links. Must be unlocked.
VMT.Linkage.childHint: The compendium that contains the linked documents.
VMT.Linkage.path: Array field path on the host document
VMT.Linkage.RunAsk: Repair the {path} links on every document in "{host}" using names from "{child}"?
VMT.Linkage.NeedPath: Enter the array field path first. Nothing changed.
VMT.Linkage.NoPack: A selected compendium no longer exists. Nothing changed.
VMT.Linkage.Same: Host and child compendiums cannot be the same. Nothing changed.
VMT.Linkage.Locked: Host compendium "{label}" is locked. Unlock it first.
VMT.Linkage.LoadFail: Could not load the compendiums. See the console. Nothing changed.
VMT.Linkage.HostEmpty: Host compendium is empty. Nothing changed.
VMT.Linkage.ChildEmpty: Child compendium is empty. Nothing changed.
VMT.Linkage.Loading: Loading compendiums, this may take a moment.
VMT.Linkage.Failed: Links not written (update failed, see console)
VMT.Linkage.ManualNeeded: Manual repairs required. The lists below are also in the console.
VMT.Linkage.Clean: No manual repairs required. Every link resolved cleanly.
VMT.Linkage.ManualBody: These entries cannot be resolved by name. Open each host document and assign the child uuid by hand.
VMT.Linkage.MissingBody: Renamed documents, documents in another compendium, or entries that still need to be created.
